description.value: Subway is a global sandwich chain serving made-to-order subs, wraps, and salads at this Vancouver Island location on 10th Avenue. The vegetarian-friendly menu and takeaway service make it a convenient refueling stop for touring cyclists passing through the area. No drive-through is present, so all service is counter-based inside the restaurant.
